conventions.convention: Thermodynamic-limit sequences start at k=1. Volume normalization is F_k/V_k; existence, derivative interchange and ensemble equivalence are separate obligations.
Phase charts have T>0, positive amounts and interior mole fractions. Pressure may be any real number. Physical state maps include the numerical-to-SI coordinate conversion.

Coexistence means an attained global entropy maximum on the exact declared feasible set. Intensive chemical potentials are amount-independent only for an intensive phase branch; g=μ requires additional same-tag homogeneity.

The fixed-T,p potential is U+p₀V−T₀S. Its global minimum is asserted on the precise system projection of the isolated-compound feasible set, with the ideal reservoir and constant-entropy pressure store explicitly included.

Reaction extents have units mol and ν is dimensionless. At an active zero-amount species, feasible directions satisfy (νh)_j≥0; the necessary minimum condition is (νᵀμ)·h≥0. Zero amounts require a separate boundary-inclusive physical model.
Clapeyron jumps are β minus α. The pressure graph requires Δv≠0; absorbed reversible molar heat for α→β is TΔs under the complete-compound reservoir assumptions.

Compact mixtures use countably additive probabilities on the relative Borel sigma algebra, coordinatewise barycenter integrals and entropy per mole. Every probability mixture with the prescribed barycenter is assumed feasible.

The phase-rule dimension counts the intensive equation zero set only, excluding phase amounts and extensive conservation constraints. It requires an invertible combined derivative minor and does not identify the zero set with stable coexistence.

load_bearing.statement: A phase branch is a model-supplied C1 diffeomorphic chart in (T,p,x,m) into the equilibrium state domain, reproducing the derivative-defined intensives and amounts n_j=mx_j. An intensive branch additionally has chemical potentials independent of m. Coexistence is an attained global entropy-maximizing endpoint on the exact declared feasible set.

At the stipulated attained global entropy maximum in open C2 positive-temperature phase charts, bilateral energy exchange implies equal temperatures; bilateral volume exchange implies equal p/T; bilateral species-j exchange implies equal μ_j/T. With energy exchange also permitted, the corresponding pressures and chemical potentials are equal.

Under the stated admitted system record, isolated-compound extension, ideal-reservoir and pressure-store assumptions, Φ=U+p₀V−T₀S does not increase. An attained global entropy maximum on the same compound feasible set gives an attained global minimum of Φ on its system projection.

For the stated one-component homogeneous smooth branches, attained interior exchange equilibrium and valid Gibbs charts, Δv(T₀,p₀)≠0 gives a unique local C1 equal-Gibbs pressure graph with dp/dT=Δs/Δv. The additional reversible complete-compound ideal-reservoir assumptions give absorbed molar latent heat ℓ=TΔs.

For nonempty compact K⊆R^d, d≥1, continuous entropy s, prescribed barycenter in conv K, and feasibility of every Borel probability mixture with that barycenter, an entropy-maximizing mixture exists with at most d+1 atoms.
